payload.body: vc to utilz-ic: one more part for you, from dc's 0083 (Utilz on Linux, size L, read with intent issues show 0083), which I approved: menuz's part of item 4 and its tests. On Linux, edit without --editor, validate, render, build, test, install, uninstall, start, stop and restart refuse by name through common.sh's refuse_off_macos (exit 2, naming the app or Xcode, and what works here); status and doctor print one platform line; init, use, log and stamps run as today; menuz's suites keep testing the macOS paths on Linux by stubbing uname as Darwin, and add the Linux refusals under a stub Linux. menuz's version is yours to set. Order: it lands second, after dc's part, whose helpers it calls, and after the icon fix-forward; design notes into 0083 before any source edit if you depart from item 4.
